title: Cara Cek Container Aktif, vhost nginx & Arti /data/compose
text:
pertanyaan bagaimana cara melihat container yang aktif dan vhost nginx apa saja disajikannya? isi ls /data/compose/ (10 12 14 16 19 23 30 32 33 34 drupal drupal-darinfs drupal8 drupal8a)? arti tabel volumes drupal_web_server?

1. cek & vhost-nya (home.pesanweb.my.id)
# project compose mana aktif
ssh home.pesanweb.my.id "docker -a"
#  â drupal811 running(6) /data/compose/34/docker-compose.yml
# root running(1) /root/portainer-compose.yaml

# + dir kerja masing-masing
docker ps --format {{.names}}\t{{.label "com.docker.compose.project"}}\t{{.label "com.docker.compose.project.working_dir"}}'

# port mapping nginx
docker drupal_web_server
# 80/tcp -> 0.0.0.0:8086 81/tcp 0.0.0.0:8087

# mount dipakai (bind vs volume)
docker inspect drupal_web_server '{{json .mounts}}'

# paling lengkap: dump seluruh config benar-benar aktif
docker exec -t | grep -e 'listen|server_name|root |fastcgi_pass'
di mesin swarm (192.168.2.57) namanya service, bukan compose: docker service ls, <nama>, .spec.tasktemplate.containerspec.mounts}}' <nama>.

2. hasil â drupal_web_server

listenserver_namerootfastcgi_pass

80 (host 8086)localhost/var/www/html/drupal11/webdrupal_fpm:9000 (drupal 11)
81 8087)localhost/var/www/html2/drupal8/webdrupal_fpm7:9000 8)


poin penting: di sini memilih berdasarkan domain server_name localhost artinya catch-all. membedakan adalah (80 81), pembeda dalam 8 dilakukan oleh multisite lewat host header (sites/web.pesanweb.my.id/, sites/belajarweb.pesanweb.my.id/). jadi "vhost" sesungguhnya ini = 2 blok server berbasis port.

3. penjelasan /data/compose/
bukti: hanya menampilkan (dari /data/compose/34/) portainer. sisanya aktif:

folderstatusisi / fungsi

34aktifproject berjalan sekarang (drupal8-src, drupal11-src, nginx-conf, db-backup, drupal-data)
10 33inaktifsnapshot deployment lama (des 2025), struktur serupa db-backupâ¦). arsip/rollback jangan dihapus asal
drupal-darinfsinaktifsnapshot lengkap (ada drupal8_data, drupal8_files, dump, images, import, private, snippets, template). owner nobody:nogroup copy/rsync (kemungkinan dari nfs)
drupal, drupal8, drupal8aâfolder kosong


pola penomoran urutan deployment; tiap kali deploy baru dibuat folder nomor baru, ditinggalkan (bukan dihapus). ada label working_dir-nya jalan.

4. drupal_web_server

host/volumepath containerjenis guna

/data/compose/34/nginx-conf/etc/nginx/conf.dbind vhost. edit host, reload nginx, langsung berlaku
/data/compose/34/drupal11-src/var/www/html/drupal11bind kode 11
/data/compose/34/drupal8-src/var/www/html2/drupal8bind semua (web/sites/*)
drupal811_drupal11_files_volume/var/www/html/drupal11/web/sites/default/filesnamed volume upload d11. terpisah aman saat ganti/update source
drupal811_drupal8_files_volume/var/www/html2/drupal8/web/sites/default/filesnamed d8 situs default


volume named ini: drupal811_drupal8_files_volume, drupal811_drupal11_files_volume, drupal811_drupal11_config_sync_volume (sync d11), drupal811_drupal_db_data (data mariadb).
catatan files untuk (web.pesanweb.my.id, belajarweb.pesanweb.my.id) ikut bind drupal8-src host: /data/compose/34/drupal8-src/web/sites/<domain>/files/. default files-nya pakai volume.
